If you\'d like to support the project, you can get a VPN subscription.

Switch VPN is an independent automation app. It is not a VPN service itself and doesn\'t create its own VPN connection — it only sends connect/disconnect commands to VPN apps already installed on your phone (Happ, Incy, v2RayTun) based on the rules you configure. For automation to work, the chosen VPN app must already be installed and set up by you. The app is in beta, so bugs are possible.\n\nSupport: t.me/aeris_support

Switch VPN doesn\'t collect, store, or transmit any data. The app doesn\'t request internet access and physically cannot send anything to a server — all settings and automation rules are stored only locally on your phone. Usage access is used only on-device to detect which app is currently open, and is never sent anywhere.\n\nSupport: t.me/aeris_support
